home.practice_scanner_blurb: Ping the fog to hear how far the nearest contact is. Cross the rings, lock each contact, and never ping one.
scanner.title: Scanner
scanner.how_to: Contacts hide in the fog. A ping answers with one number: how many steps (up, down, left or right, never diagonal) to the nearest hidden contact. Nothing lies nearer, so those cells are shaded; one lies exactly that far, somewhere on the ping's ring. When the rings leave a contact one cell, lock it. A ping that lands on a contact spooks it, and a lock on empty space misses: either costs points and the streak. So ping where it is shaded, and lock where it must be.
scanner.how_to_keyboard: Arrows or WASD move the cursor. Space pings, enter or L locks, X flips the switch. A long press always locks. Tap a number to light its ring.
scanner.live_note: The numbers are live: when a contact is found, every ping that heard it sounds again for the nearest one still hidden.
scanner.par_note: A sector allows two pings a contact; each one past that costs 10. Cleared within it with no mistake, a sector is clean: every ping left over pays 20, and clean sectors in a row build a streak that multiplies bounties and savings, up to double.
scanner.fair_note: Every sector opens with one ping made for you, and can be cleared from there with no guess.
scanner.hint_note: Practice rounds point out a safe move when you pause.
scanner.legend_fog: Fog. A contact may be here. A ping here risks spooking one.
scanner.legend_clear: Proven empty by the numbers. Safe to ping; takes no lock.
scanner.legend_ping: A ping. Its number is the steps to the nearest hidden contact. Tap it to light its ring: the bright cells are where that contact can be.
scanner.legend_found: A contact found by a lock: 40, times the streak.
scanner.legend_spooked: A contact spooked by a ping: no bounty, and it costs 60.
scanner.legend_miss: A lock on empty space: it costs 60.
harness.preset.scanner_first_deal: First deal stands: a sector may need a guess
harness.preset.scanner_big_sector: A big sector: eight by eight, four to eight contacts
harness.preset.scanner_tight_par: Tight par: one ping a contact, and two
harness.preset.scanner_no_opening: No opening ping: the first ping is a gamble
harness.probe.scanner.wide_open: the opening ping is five steps or more from every contact
harness.probe.scanner.one_ring: the opening ping already proves a contact
harness.probe.scanner.huddle: two contacts open side by side
